card.name: Single digits inside long ID numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long digit string, such as an ISBN, phone number, DOI or numeric URL. It responds in web reference and citation text, not in dose numbers.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit inside an ISBN in a book citation or product listing.

modes.label: URL or DOI digits
modes.description: A digit inside a numeric article address or DOI.

modes.label: Phone number digits
modes.description: A digit inside a phone number.

card.plain: It fires on one digit in the middle of a long identifier like an ISBN, phone number or web link.
